AllUnits.Name: Archer
AllUnits.Description: A ranged unit that shoots arrows.

AllUnits.Name: Martian
AllUnits.Description: Shoots confusion ray low damage applies slow, ability kidnaps enemy and generates money

AllUnits.Name: orbital laser terminal
AllUnits.Description: has no basic attack can slowly generate ability power passively, ability calls down lazer doing massive damage to all on one tile goes for strongest on board

AllUnits.Name: Bounty Hunter
AllUnits.Description: Targets highest health character generates flux based on kills, ability throws electro mine that stuns all characters on tile of highest health character

AllUnits.Name: spores
AllUnits.Description: Fume shroom with dot, ability spreads debuff to adjacent rows

AllUnits.Name: Facehugger nest
AllUnits.Description: deploys face hugger than runs down lane, applies massive slow and when enemy dies will summon zombie/monster to fight, ability for each summon that died this round apply permanant buffs to surrounding units

AllUnits.Name: Xenomorph
AllUnits.Description: extends tail 2 tiles doing piercing damage, next applies the facehugger effect aka summing zombie

AllUnits.Name: electric katana
AllUnits.Description: hits front enemy and sends spark going back 1 row at a time, ability applies damage to all enemies on screen

AllUnits.Name: Hero
AllUnits.Description: at far range shoots bow otherwise has sword for close, ability inspire gives 20% attack speed to all in column

AllUnits.Name: Wizard
AllUnits.Description: Shoots fireballs doing splash damage, ability player selects enemy to turn into sheep (reg enemy 5 seconds, boss 2) or can set to autotarget

AllUnits.Name: Trebuchet
AllUnits.Description: Shoots rocks at # number of enemies, ability attacked 3 times

AllUnits.Name: Orc
AllUnits.Description: If no enemy in front throw axe otherwise does more damage in front, ability increases attack speed by 50% for 5 seconds can stack

AllUnits.Name: Magic Sword
AllUnits.Description: When this unit is placed, also place a ‘portal’ that the magic sword can attack but can’t be attacked through. Attacks enemies within 1 tile of itself and 2 tiles around the portal’s location. ability spawns a portal on a random enemy for the rest of the round

AllUnits.Name: Dragon
AllUnits.Description: Applies shoots fire out, applying fire effect, ability sets fire dot on all enemies on the board

AllUnits.Name: Seer
AllUnits.Description: gives random ally # mana, ability gives a duplicate item (adds # number of copies of tower into deck)

AllUnits.Name: squire
AllUnits.Description: applys # damage to one nearby towers attack, applies +# attack buff to surrounding towers

AllUnits.Name: Drone
AllUnits.Description: Has a summon tile but is a unit that moves around following closest enemy in all rows but does less damage, ability summons 3 temporary drones for 4 seconds (they dont get ability)

AllUnits.Name: Crypto Miner
AllUnits.Description: Generates currency based on the amount of tech units and their level, ability  generates an amount of currency based on all tech kills for the next 3 seconds

AllUnits.Name: Mech
AllUnits.Description: At close range has sword that covers 2 squares, otherwise shoots lasers, ability missles rain choose % tiles to shoot missles damaging all on that tile

AllUnits.Name: Laser trooper
AllUnits.Description: Fires laser that hits all in lane low damage, ability next laser +ability damage

AllUnits.Name: Stim-bot
AllUnits.Description: Gives a selected unit attack speed must be behind,ability gives # ult charge to 3 parallel units

AllUnits.Name: Foot trooper
AllUnits.Description: Basic just fires rifle, ability throws grenade

AllUnits.Name: Minigun
AllUnits.Description: rapid fire rate but will overheat, ability shoot for 5 seconds with no heat

AllUnits.Name: Rods from God
AllUnits.Description: Shoots rods that gain damage the further they go, ability drops a massive bomb doing # damage to # tiles

AllUnits.Name: artillery
AllUnits.Description: shoots explosive 1 tile behind closest enemy, ability crew loads 20% faster for rest of round

AllUnits.Name: Sniper
AllUnits.Description: Targets highest health character, ability enhances next bullet making target take 20% more damage from all damage sources until death

AllUnits.Name: Land mine deployer
AllUnits.Description: will deploy mines on tiles with no enemy on it doing massive damage, ability throws mines at enemies for each mine currently on the field

AllUnits.Name: Tank
AllUnits.Description: Launches a tank shell very rarely at any location on the map large health pool, ability quickly fire 3 shells

AllUnits.Name: Riot Control
AllUnits.Description: When it takes damage, gives thorn damage. ability shoves all enemys in 1 tile back 3

AllUnits.Name: Generator
AllUnits.Description: Spawns a small amount of currency every time it casts

AllUnits.Name: Jester
AllUnits.Description: High single target damage, ability gives one random adjacent ally (1x-6x random) stats for X seconds

AllUnits.Name: Gnome catapult
AllUnits.Description: shoots rocks, ability shoots a gnome that will fight down the lane

AllUnits.Name: Fairy
AllUnits.Description: Generates currency for player, ability heal x amount of health on lowest tower gain flux for overhealth

AllUnits.Name: Magic archer
AllUnits.Description: Attacks bounce of # number of targets scaling off damage but only gains 50% of benefits of damage, ability arrow rain high dps on one tile for 5 seconds

AllUnits.Name: Minotaur
AllUnits.Description: is a tanky character that does no damage but can push one enemy at a time back, has lots of hp, ability knocks enemys back 3 tiles in lane

AllUnits.Name: alchemist
AllUnits.Description: Summons little golems that run down lane, little damage high health explode on death, ability summons golems on nearby rows and buffs all that are already alive

AllUnits.Name: Baba Yaga
AllUnits.Description: Applies dots on closest enemy without dot, ability turns a non boss against enemy(like hypno shroom)

AllUnits.Name: Unicorn
AllUnits.Description: Heals lowest % ally, ability bigger heal

AllUnits.Name: Fire priestess
AllUnits.Description: gives fire on hit to a unit for the rest of the round, ability generates flux based on active fire stacks

AllUnits.Name: Rock Man
AllUnits.Description: Throws moderate rocks with low attack speed, Ability throws boulder that effects 3x3 radius applies armor shred and slow for 3 seconds

AllUnits.Name: Farmer
AllUnits.Description: Generates # flux, ability gives a the onion card

AllUnits.Name: Bowman
AllUnits.Description: Targets highest health character, ability causing 3 second stun

AllUnits.Name: Stick
AllUnits.Description: Low damage and range however quick attack speed does little knockback, ability upgrades to spear upgrading range and damage but removing knockback

AllUnits.Name: Boomeranger
AllUnits.Description: Moves 2 tiles after hitting first enemy, Throws 3 boomerangs that movethroughout whole lane

AllUnits.Name: war drums
AllUnits.Description: calls (easy to make dinosaur model) down to attack, ability gives whole column # ap for the rest of the round

AllUnits.Name: Firemaker
AllUnits.Description: All adjacent units gain fire damage, ability all adjacent units apply 5 stacks on their next attack

AllUnits.Name: Fairy
AllUnits.Description: Mystic generation unit that generates currency for player, heals lowest health tower, and gains flux from overhealing

AllUnits.Name: Fire Priestess
AllUnits.Description: Mystic generation and support unit that applies fire on hit to enemies, ability generates flux based on active fire stacks on enemies
